title: Stream GTA 6 in India Without Owning a PS5
description: Want to stream GTA 6 on launch week but don't own a PS5 or Xbox? Book a console slot at a gaming cafe on the Hash app and stream from there. Here is how.

body.text: GTA 6 launch week will be the biggest moment of the year for gaming streamers, and every Indian creator wants to be live for it. The catch: GTA 6 runs only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and the Standard Edition costs ₹5,999 in India. If you do not own a current console, a gaming cafe slot is the fastest way to get GTA 6 on your stream.
Why stream GTA 6 from a gaming cafe

items: No console or game to buy: the cafe has the hardware ready.
Go live on launch week instead of waiting to save up.
Gaming cafes often have good screens and seating for long sessions.
Bring your squad and make it a group stream.

body.text: How to book a console slot for your GTA 6 stream

items: Open the Hash app and look at gaming cafes near you.
Pick a cafe with a PS5 or Xbox Series X|S and check that it has GTA 6.
Ask the cafe whether you can connect your capture setup or stream from your phone.
Reserve your slot in advance so your stream starts on time.

body.text: Bookings on Hash earn HashCoins, and streamers earn more HashCoins by streaming tournaments on the app. Mix your GTA 6 streams with tournament streams on Hash and you get rewarded on both, redeemable on passes, offers and gear.
Lock your launch week slot on the Hash app before the cafes near you fill up.
